variables.name: Gate charm given

lore_items.name: Gran' Wizard's Bell Cord
lore_items.description:
A length of the cord the Gran' Wizard rang his bell with, strung with the teeth of the ones the bell called. It is quiet now. The cannibals will know it on sight.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Meat Lord's Fork
lore_items.description:
The Meat Lord's own fork, worn smooth, on a cord through a hole in its handle. He said forks were everything. Whoever wears it is a guest who did not stay for dinner.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Alder Quill's Token
lore_items.description:
A kitchen priest's medal of the Holy Nation, its sun scratched out and a fork cut in its place. Alder Quill wore it under his robe. The Cities and the Nation both paid for his end.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Mother Brine's Token
lore_items.description:
A cure-house tally of knotted cord and salt-white teeth, one for every barrel Mother Brine filled. It still smells of smoke.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Gate Sinew Knot
lore_items.description:
A knot of beast sinew the Gate Folk tie on the ones who feed the gate. Hush wears one. Past the gate the cannibals know what it means, and hate it.

Worn in the neck slot.

say: Friend of gate. Hush says it slow. Here. Sinew knot. Little ones tie it.
You feed gate many times. Take dhis. Knot of beast. Kin past gate see it, kin know you ours.
